alex: Observed EU p95 surge ~23:02 UTC, started ~22:55. Not 5xxs but latency blips on /v1/gen. Suggest holding EU release window and re-evaluating in 30m.

deploybot: ACTION: release-queue PAUSED by alex at 3361001234. Scope: region=eu. Hold ID: hold-3361.

sam_ops: on it. Running connection pool reset on app nodes, draining long requests. Rebalancing traffic to standby cluster. ETA 20m.

maya: please don't auto-rollback. Plan: pin current canary v3.2.3, delay window 12 hours, prepare staged resume. We'll only rollback if p95 remains >1.25x baseline after mitigation.

taylor: which rollback target? v3.2.2 is last known-good. Rollback doc: /docs/runbooks/rollback.md.

alex: pinning canary and blocking new slots. cmd: `./tools/pin_release --region eu --version v3.2.3 --reason "post-incident hold"`

maya: deploybot, requeue eu-night -> 2026-03-23T09:00Z. Command: `/requeue --slot eu-night --new-start 2026-03-23T09:00Z --note "deferred after latency spike"`

deploybot: OK requeue accepted. Notifying #customers-notify when notes are updated.

sam_ops: mitigation applied; p95 trending down to ~4% over baseline. Will observe for 15m.

maya: drafting release note: "EU release delayed; canary pinned to v3.2.3 while we investigate transient latency. No action required." Will sync with growth for public blurb.

taylor: if metrics are back in 30m, do staggered resume: canary -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> full. Include monitoring checks between steps.

alex: opening PM stub PM-3361.

deploy-notify-bot: REMINDER: hold hold-3361 expires at 3361001454. Use `/hold extend hold-3361 --minutes 30` to extend.

maya: extending 30m `/hold extend hold-3361 --minutes 30`

sam_ops: will report back in 15m.

maya: reconvene here then. :thumbsup:
